name: Vermilion City Arena & Kanto Leader Rematches
summary: Following your triumph atop Mt. Silver, the Vermilion City Arena opens its doors to the world's most formidable trainers. The 8 Kanto Gym Leaders venture out into the overworld on designated weekly schedules (Brock at Pewter Museum, Misty at Cerulean Cape, Lt. Surge at Vermilion Harbor, Erika in Celadon Greenhouse, Koga in Fuchsia City, Sabrina in Saffron Dojo, Blaine in Cinnabar Lab, and Giovanni at Viridian Gym). Interacting with them registers a formal rematch duel at the Vermilion Arena. Face their upgraded, competitive 6 vs 6 rosters (Levels 80 to 85) featuring competitive hold items and strategic synergy.

items.name: Choice Band
items.method: Purchased with battle points from the prize vendor in the Vermilion Arena lounge

items.name: Choice Specs
items.method: Purchased with battle points from the prize vendor in the Vermilion Arena lounge

items.name: Arena Ribbon
